inngest.heading: Background Jobs - Inngest
inngest.intro: Inngest runs durable, multi-step background jobs that survive server restarts. Each step is retried independently on failure.
inngest.stepReportDescription: Aggregate data and produce a report
inngest.triggerErrorDevServer: Is the Inngest dev server running? Try: bun run inngest:dev
inngest.jobStepsDescription: Trigger this job and watch it execute step-by-step in the Inngest dashboard.
inngest.triggeredRunsDescription: Jobs triggered this session. Status updates automatically as each run executes.
inngest.noRunsDescription: Trigger the demo job to see it appear here with live status.
inngest.howItWorksBody: The "Trigger Job" button calls a tRPC mutation that sends an Inngest event. The job publishes a status message over <realtimeLink>Inngest Realtime</realtimeLink> as it enters each step (see the <code1>publish()</code1> calls in <code2>src/inngest/functions.ts</code2>). The badge on each run subscribes to that run's channel via <code3>useInngestSubscription</code3> - no polling, updates stream in as they happen. Open <dashboardLink>localhost:8288</dashboardLink> to see the full run trace. The dev server must be running (<code4>bun run inngest:dev</code4> or via <code5>docker compose up -d</code5>).

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains which personal data this service processes, why, and what rights you have.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text: The controller under the GDPR is {name}, {address}. For all questions about your data write to {email}.

data.title: Which data we process and why
data.account: Account data (name, email address, password as a salted hash, optional profile picture, language): to create and run your account. Legal basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
data.sessions: Sign-in sessions (IP address, browser and device information, time): to keep you signed in and to protect your account, for example by letting you see and end your sessions. Legal basis: legitimate interest in the security of the service (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
data.content: Content you create in the service (for example posts): to provide the features you use. Legal basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
data.email: Transactional emails (email verification, password reset, account deletion): to carry out the action you requested. Legal basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
data.billing: Billing data (customer record and subscription status; card details are handled by the payment provider only): to process your subscription and to meet tax and accounting duties. Legal basis: performance of the contract and legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(b) and (c) GDPR).
data.logs: Technical server logs (for example IP address and request time): to operate the service securely and to find faults. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
data.errors: Error reports (technical details about an error, the page, browser and approximate location): to find and fix errors. Legal basis: legitimate interest in a stable service (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
data.analytics: Anonymous usage statistics without cookies and without personal profiles: to understand how the service is used. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
data.ai: Messages you write in the AI chat are sent to the AI provider named below to generate the answer. They are not stored on our server beyond a short technical buffer of up to 24 hours. Legal basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), you decide whether to use the feature.

recipients.title: Who receives your data
recipients.intro: We use the following service providers. They process data on our behalf under a data processing agreement, or as independent controllers where the law requires so.
recipients.openrouter: AI chat: OpenRouter and the AI model provider it forwards your messages to.
recipients.google: Sign-in with Google (only if you choose it): Google.
recipients.github: Sign-in with GitHub (only if you choose it): GitHub.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.text: We only use storage that is strictly necessary to provide the service you asked for, so no consent banner is needed. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
cookies.session: Session cookie: keeps you signed in. Removed when the session ends.
cookies.sidebar: Sidebar cookie (sidebar_state): remembers whether the menu is collapsed.
cookies.browser: Browser storage (IndexedDB, session storage and a service worker cache): speeds up the app and keeps drafts. It is wiped when you sign out.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.account: Account data and your content: until you delete your account.
retention.sessions: Sessions: until they expire (7 days at most), expired sessions are deleted every day.
retention.tokens: Email verification and password reset links: until they expire, then they are deleted every day.
retention.billing: Billing records: as long as tax and accounting law requires, at the payment provider.
retention.logs: Server logs and error reports: for the period set by the hosting and error tracking providers.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and to object to processing based on legitimate interest. Most of this you can do yourself:
rights.access: Access and data portability: download all your data as a file under Settings > Privacy.
rights.rectification: Rectification: change your profile under Settings > Account.
rights.erasure: Erasure: delete your account under Settings > Privacy. Your data is deleted, an active subscription is cancelled.
rights.other: For everything else, for example restriction or objection, write to {email}.
rights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example in the country where you live.
